text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ has rebuilt her winning
equation
from the ground up in
preparation for the Kikuka
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
During that process, she has gained a
newfound
intensity. Even Нарита Таисин
and Уиннинг Тикит
can't help but notice
the difference.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The BNW showdown is about to take
place in the
final Classic race, and
sparks are sure to fly!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
